checks.name: actual_car_selection_final

checks.name: existing_ui_regressions_final

RESULT_HIGHLIGHT_VALIDATION_PASS: per-player snapshot, factual fallback, DNF, AUTO label, compact presentation, 720p/1080p renders.

checks.name: deterministic_previews
evidence: UI_MOTION_CAPTURE_PASS: four production-component animation sequences at 960x540 / 25 fps.

regression_reproduced_then_fixed: Initial result rank pulse cached an in-progress reveal pose; new Play Mode pose assertions fail before the fix and pass after it, for both first display and reentry.
scope: All automated component, GC, player-loop, full race-flow, car-selection, existing UI regression and EditMode checks passed on the final implementation commit.
GC measurements cover warmed target components on the executing thread, not whole-game GC or device FPS.
Previews use production components with explicit time stepping and fixture data; live captures use SampleScene with injected inputs and debug finish records.
Physical pedals, target display hardware and on-device performance were not tested.
